_doc: factory.json — the consumer manifest schema (ac-1p7j.11). The ONE place an app declares the bindings registry skills read as literals today. Copy this file into the app repo as .claude/factory.json, fill every '<SET: ...>' value, and registry skills read keys, never literals. Keys starting with '_' are reserved comments. The shipping spine checks the ship block's shape with jq at run start — missing or malformed refuses NOT-GATED. Filling any app is OUT of scope here (WS4).
design_spec: <SET: path to the app's design spec the UI skills read>
journeys_dir: <SET: path to the Playwright journeys dir the QA skills read>
routes_manifest: <SET: path to the authenticated routes manifest>
routes_public_manifest: <SET: path to the public routes manifest>
ui_audit: <SET: path to the UI audit/visual-craft entry doc>
serve_prod: <SET: command that serves the production build locally for device QA>

ship._doc: the ship block: preflight[] runs first, then prove (prints the proven SHA on its last line — non-zero is FAIL, missing is NOT-GATED), then each target's promote + verify (promote moves the proven artifact, never rebuilds; verify reads back the SHA and build number that actually shipped). A null step is logged SKIP (declared); version null means no bump and no tag; beta only on targets that can take a test build. Rules: skills/ac-publish/references/ship-contract.md. The shipping spine checks this block's shape with jq at run start — missing or malformed refuses NOT-GATED.
preflight: <SET: one command per array entry, run before the ship>
targets: <SET: {name, promote, verify}, beta? only on targets that can take a test build>

autopilot._doc: autopilot: the unattended hourly gate's contract (read only by skills/_tools/autopilot.sh). enabled is flipped by the human and nothing else; implement false means polish only; max_priority is the lowest-urgency priority it may touch (0-1 = P0-P1); width and cap bound one run. protect is an ERE over repo-relative paths: a diff touching a match is never auto-committed. It covers .claude/ so autopilot cannot edit its own limits; git log on this file is the authorization record.

store._doc: store ids the distribution skill reads (never literals in skill text)

triage._doc: triage sensor bindings (Sentry/Supabase) the triage skill reads

human._doc: the human operator the factory serves
human.name: <SET: the human's name>

memory._doc: memory substrate roots the substrate trio reads
memory.root: <SET: path to the app's memory root>
